snippet.title: NewoZero V4 Dec2023 Trailer #wii #homebrew
snippet.description:
A galactic race over and below NewoTokyo. Use your piloting skills to race through 80 levels. Features 3d graphics, and optional wiimote sideways motion controls for driving. 
More information and download available at: https://wiibrew.org/wiki/Newo_Zero
Works in DolphinEmu or homebrewed wii using the homebrew channel.

Trailer by @MusicMX876 -  https://www.youtube.com/c/MusicMX876
@dolphinemuorg
